Name: Dorking Sports Centre holiday activities
Short_Description: School-holiday activities at Dorking Sports Centre, as listed on Better's holiday activities page. These have included Aqua Splash (ages 8–16 who can swim a full main-pool length), Swim School short courses, Junior Gym morning sessions (11–17, induction required), Family Fun Swimming, an Inclusive Swim session described as suitable for those with disabilities who may enjoy a quieter pool, Toddlers World soft play in the holidays (under 7s welcomed), and a holiday playscheme. Dates change each holiday — check Better.
When: School holidays. Check the Better holiday activities page for the current dates and session times.
Booking_Note: Book through Better. The October 2026 half-term timetable was the one published when this was checked; later holidays will differ.
Verify_Note: Official Better holiday activities page for Dorking Sports Centre, 22 November 2026, plus Ofsted's listing of a Dorking Sports Centre Holiday Playscheme (out-of-school care). Inclusive=Y is only because that Better page explicitly describes Inclusive Swim. Session lists are seasonal and should be re-checked each holiday. Some of these activities also appear on the Sports & activities layer.

Name: High Ashurst Outdoor Learning — holiday activities
Short_Description: Surrey County Council's outdoor centre at Mickleham, offering school-holiday adventure days for ages 6–13, including ropes, climbing, mountain biking, archery, bushcraft and orienteering. Activities here are land-based only.
Venue: High Ashurst (Surrey Outdoor Learning and Development)
When: School holidays. The Adventure Zone days are drop-off 9:30am and pick-up 4:15pm, in 6–9 and 10–13 groups.
Booking_Note: Book through Surrey Outdoor Learning. Other holiday courses have included two-day mountain biking and intro climbing (9–13).
Verify_Note: Official Surrey Outdoor Learning holiday page, already used for the Sports & activities pin. Duplicated here so it appears on the Holiday clubs layer. Inclusive is not marked: the official page was not used as evidence of a dedicated SEND session.
